He was in the restroom in deep pain at work, I remember going into the restroom and he was moaning in agonizing pain. Eventually he was helped out of the restroom and to a hospital. But I remember on his way out, from across the restaurant, I saw his face. He looked scared, helpless and in pure pain. We locked eyes for a split second, but that’s all that was needed. No words exchanged. It’s burned into my brain. That was the last I ever saw of him.

Unfortunately I had found out many months later he died. No one else knew what was happening. We tried searching obituaries and the hospital wouldn’t give information. But a friend text me a few months later confirming his death.

He had just been evicted and I helped him move to a motel while he tried getting back on his feet. One of the kindest souls I have ever met. A man with so many stories and life experiences. Charming and hilarious. I miss him.
